title: Separate author claims from independent verification
statement: As a reviewer, I can inspect falsifiable author claims and independent verification history, so that I can distinguish an assertion from the evidence that tested it.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Each author claim states one falsifiable assertion.
Each author claim identifies the explanation it qualifies.
Each author claim links to exact supporting source.
Recording a verification does not rewrite the claim.
Recording a verification preserves every earlier verification result.
A failed verification remains visible in the claim's history.
